kjv.texto: At the west side four thousand and five hundred, with their three gates; one gate of Gad, one gate of Asher, one gate of Naphtali.

vizinhos.33: And at the south side four thousand and five hundred measures: and three gates; one gate of Simeon, one gate of Issachar, one gate of Zebulun.
vizinhos.35: It was round about eighteen thousand measures: and the name of the city from that day shall be, The Lord is there.

versos.texto_bv: O perímetro total será de dezoito mil côvados. E o nome da cidade, desde aquele dia, será: “O SENHOR está ali.”
versos.traducao_literal: Ao-redor, dezoito mil; e-nome-de a-cidade, de-dia, SENHOR ali.

anteriores.texto: E no lado sul, quatro mil e quinhentos côvados de medida, com três portas: a porta de Simeão, a porta de Issacar, a porta de Zebulom.
No lado ocidental, quatro mil e quinhentos côvados, com três portas: a porta de Gade, a porta de Aser, a porta de Naftali.

kjv.texto: It was round about eighteen thousand measures: and the name of the city from that day shall be, The Lord is there.

vizinhos.34: At the west side four thousand and five hundred, with their three gates; one gate of Gad, one gate of Asher, one gate of Naphtali.
